description: This file declares an abstract class `Tpm` within the `cuttlefish` namespace, serving as an interface for TPM (Trusted Platform Module) interactions. It includes a destructor and a pure virtual method `TctiContext()` that returns a pointer to a TSS2_TCTI_CONTEXT.

classes.name: Tpm
classes.description: Abstract class defining an interface for TPM interactions, primarily providing a method to access the TCTI context.

methods.name: ~Tpm
methods.description: Virtual destructor ensuring proper cleanup for derived classes.

methods.name: TctiContext
methods.description: Pure virtual method to obtain the TPM's TCTI context.
